about: Beckwith is a township in Lanark County, Ontario, immediately southwest of the separate Town of Carleton Place—not Carleton Place itself. Black’s Corners (the municipal office hamlet), Prospect, Franktown, and rural lots toward the Mississippi River define the township. About 9,000 people live in Beckwith Township.
